svg.aria-label: M0 · 2026-10: Clean slate. Done. Old names removed. Blueprint CI green in a repo. M1 · 2026-11: Spine runs locally. In progress. docker compose up starts edge, bus, database, telemetry, pulse. The dev deploy waits for a host. M2 · 2027-01: Chat slice on dev. Planned. A passkey user gets streamed answers in an embedded chat. M3 · 2027-02: MVP on prd. Planned. The approved stg build runs on prd. Restore drill done. M4 · 2027-04: Public demo. Planned. Public site with live chat, vision and the mascot. M5 · 2027-05: Paid plans and SDK apps. Planned. Checkout changes entitlements. App templates for React and Vue. M6 · 2027-06: Cluster-ready. Planned. Same images on k3s. Security review closed. Card scan works. M0-M6: Targets are estimates. Estimates are not promises. This line is
